purpose: Teach: といふ/劼/氣/ゎ/榮/佛/に当たりまして/翁

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、古文書の「といふ」、つまり「という」の用法を、警察、解読されますね
lines.en: In this case, we're looking at the classical usage of 「といふ」—the old form of 「という」—in the old documents, aren't we?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Leaning into the intellectual puzzle. Respectful but genuinely curious—like he's thinking aloud with someone he trusts to follow. Slight upward lilt on the question, inviting confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の「劼」、つまり劼勉な振る舞いを、警察、慎重に観察されますね
lines.en: We at the department will observe the suspect's diligent behavior carefully, won't we?
lines.style: Calm, reassuring tone. Professional but not stiff. A slight nod in the voice—confirming the plan without drama. Steady pacing, like laying out steps that are already decided.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、旧字「氣」、つまり気の入った古文書を、警察、鑑定されますね
lines.en: In this case, we'll need to authenticate the old character 「氣」—the full-form 気—in these old documents, won't we?
lines.style: Attentive, turning over the detail carefully. Slower pace on the character names. There's a light precision to it—like he's handling something fragile. Mild question inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ノートの小書きのゎ、つまり「わ」のクセも、警察、筆跡鑑定されますね
lines.en: We'll also examine the small notations in the notebook—especially the particular way he writes the particle 「わ」—through handwriting analysis, won't we?
lines.style: Focused, methodical. Each phrase lands distinctly. No rush. The voice of someone building a case brick by brick. Professional courtesy underneath—not lecturing, collaborating.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、旧字「榮」、つまり栄の戦前帳簿を、警察、解読されますね
lines.en: In this case, the old character 「榮」—the full form of 栄—appears in these prewar account books. We'll need to decode them, won't we?
lines.style: Engaged but careful. Slight pause before naming the character, like he's setting it in context. Steady, methodical delivery. There's respect in how he handles the historical detail.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧字「佛」、つまり仏壇からの盗難事件を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: We'll investigate the theft from the altar—the case involving the old character 「佛」 for 仏壇—thoroughly, won't we?
lines.style: Steady and committed. Clear articulation of the stakes. Professional but with an undertone of genuine care for getting it right. No hesitation, no rushing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、捜査開始に当たりまして、警察、ご家族にご挨拶されますね
lines.en: As we begin this investigation, we'll need to pay our respects to the family, won't we?
lines.style: Thoughtful, respectful tone. Slower, more deliberate pace. There's an acknowledgment of protocol and human dignity both. A slight gravity—this is about people, not just facts.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者の翁、つまり老翁から事情を、警察、丁寧に伺われますね
lines.en: We'll speak carefully and considerately with the elderly witness—the elderly man who saw what happened—won't we?
lines.style: Gentle, patient delivery. The voice of someone who knows how to listen without pushing. Warm undertone—there's real respect for the witness. Unhurried pace, space for meaning.
